clue.text: Buzzer was quiet

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Something that used to buzz has fallen silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A wasp is an insect known for the droning noise of its wings, so it is a buzzer.

clue.text: Wife chooses to be topless for burning needs

indicators.note: being topless here means the word for chooses loses its first letter

explanation.surface: A wife opts to go without a top, apparently for some fiery reason.
explanation.walkthrough: The racy surface hides a plain beheading of the synonym for chooses.
explanation.definitionFit: Candles and oil lamps require wicks in order to burn, so wicks are things a flame needs.

clue.text: Prepared litmus paper to show causes of reactions

indicators.note: prepared means made ready or worked up, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: the i is a British daily newspaper, sister to the Independent

explanation.surface: Litmus paper is made ready to show how a chemical reaction goes.
explanation.walkthrough: The i is a UK newspaper, so paper gives the single letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Stimuli are things that provoke a response, which is what causes a reaction.

clue.text: Some train as astronauts or rocket scientists here

indicators.note: some of the words, meaning the answer is a run of letters inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of train, the word as and the start of astronauts

explanation.surface: A place where astronauts and rocket scientists are trained.
explanation.definitionFit: The US space agency employs rocket scientists, so they would be found there.

clue.text: Fruit drink — about a couple of pennies

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the drink goes round the pennies

parts.note: P is a penny, so two of them make PP

explanation.surface: A fruity drink that costs only a couple of pence.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple is a common orchard fruit.

clue.text: Partly open a container

explanation.surface: Someone half opens a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left ajar is slightly open, not fully shut.

clue.text: Support an opinion

parts.note: my bet is that means my opinion is that

explanation.surface: Someone backs a particular point of view.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to help or encourage, usually in wrongdoing, which is a form of backing.

clue.text: Library support on shelf K?

definitions.meaning: a prop that keeps books upright on a shelf
the letter K is the end of the word BOOK

explanation.surface: A library prop is needed on the shelf marked K.
explanation.walkthrough: Shelf K sounds like a library section, but K is literally the final letter of the word book.
explanation.definitionFit: A bookend is a heavy block placed at the end of a row of books to stop them falling over.

clue.text: Capture base with new steel instrument

indicators.note: new tells you the letters come in a fresh order

parts.note: to cop is to catch or nab
e is the base of natural logarithms

explanation.surface: An instrument is caught with a fresh steel base.
explanation.definitionFit: A telescope is an optical device for viewing distant objects.

clue.text: Spread blanket at the top, say

indicators.note: at the top of a word is its first letter, so only the opening of blanket is used

explanation.surface: Someone spreads a blanket over the top of the bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Blanket looks like bedding to be spread; it only supplies its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Butter is the classic dairy spread smeared on bread and toast.

clue.text: Leader of revolutionary force capturing island

indicators.note: capturing means holding something inside

parts.note: Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A rebel commander and his troops seize an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief is a head or boss, the person in charge.

clue.text: "Trees" with T at the front!

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about putting T at the start of the word trees.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface says to put T at the front, but the T goes at the back of the trees; at the front is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming first means being in the leading position.

clue.text: Put ale in supply boxes close to oleo cooking fluid

indicators.note: boxes means encloses, so the rearranged letters surround the other piece
read as supple-ly, meaning flexibly, so the letters bend into a new order
the close of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Pour beer into supply crates near the margarine.
explanation.walkthrough: Supply looks like a noun or verb but is an adverb meaning in a supple way. Oleo is an old American word for margarine.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundnut oil is widely used for frying, so it is a liquid used in cooking.

clue.text: Son making a stink essentially in row in store

indicators.note: making means the a becomes something else, a swap of letters
the essence of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: A son kicks up a stink during an argument in a shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Stink and row suggest a fuss, but stink only gives its middle letter to replace the A of the argument word.
explanation.definitionFit: To squirrel away is to hoard or stash something for later, like the animal hiding nuts.

clue.text: Some parents heading off for rest

indicators.note: the heading is the first letter, which comes off

parts.note: mothers are some of the parents

explanation.surface: A few parents leave to have a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The rest means the remaining people or things, the others.

clue.text: Recalled small spoiled fish

indicators.note: called back, so the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: food that has spoiled has gone bad

explanation.surface: A batch of little rotten fish is recalled by the seller.
explanation.definitionFit: Dabs are a species of small flatfish caught off European coasts, so a dab is an example of a fish.

clue.text: Group still in middle of winter? On the contrary

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other
reverses the clue's order of containment, so the winter letters go inside the quiet word
the two central letters of the word

parts.note: six letters, so its middle is the central pair

explanation.surface: Musings on calm in midwinter.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally the calm word would go inside winter; the final phrase flips which piece holds which.
explanation.definitionFit: A quintet is a set of five, especially five musicians.

clue.text: It draws in the hearts of local workers, envisaging panda confined to pound

indicators.note: confined means held within, so the hearts go inside the pound word

parts.note: a quid is slang for a pound sterling

indicators.note: the central letter or letters of each of the following words

parts.note: its central letter is the third of five
its central letter is the fourth of seven
ten letters, so its heart is the central pair
its central letter is the third of five

explanation.surface: Local workers imagine a panda shut in a pen.
explanation.walkthrough: Pound looks like an animal enclosure for the panda but is money. Envisaging has ten letters, so its heart is two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Quicksand is wet loose ground that sucks down anything stepping onto it.

clue.text: Withdrawing issue's negative votes

indicators.note: drawing back, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: a son is issue, offspring; the 's is read as is, a link

explanation.surface: Pulling a proposal after the votes go against it.
explanation.walkthrough: Issue looks like a matter for debate but means offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Noes are votes cast against a motion.

clue.text: Opening of Christmas poem student finally understood on reflection

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word
reflected as in a mirror, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: to see is to understand, as in I see

explanation.surface: A student finally grasps a Christmas poem after thinking it over.
explanation.walkthrough: The poem is A Visit from St Nicholas, which begins 'Twas the night before Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous festive verse starts with this contracted word for it was.

clue.text: Fancy diorama that's a source of a lot of talk

definitions.text: a source of a lot of talk

indicators.note: fancy means elaborate or ornamental, so the letters are dressed up in a new order

explanation.surface: An elaborate model display gets everyone chatting.
explanation.walkthrough: AM radio is the medium-wave band used by many talk-radio stations.
explanation.definitionFit: Talk radio stations largely broadcast on medium wave, so that band provides much chat.

clue.text: Father of graduate retiring at university

indicators.note: withdrawing, so the letters go backwards

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate

explanation.surface: A dad who graduated is now retiring from his university post.
explanation.walkthrough: Abu is Arabic for father, as in many Arabic names.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arabic naming the word means father of, used before a child's name.

clue.text: Network with live revolutionary

indicators.note: turning round, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: to be is to live or exist

explanation.surface: A network that includes a living radical.
explanation.definitionFit: A web is an interconnected mesh, as in a web of contacts.

clue.text: Old scholar starts to improve brilliant next step in numerical algorithm

indicators.note: take the starting letter of each following word

parts.words: improve brilliant next step in numerical algorithm
parts.note: the seven words each supply their opening letter

explanation.surface: A historic mathematician begins refining a clever algorithm.
explanation.walkthrough: Ibn Sina, known in the West as Avicenna, was a Persian polymath of around 1000 AD.
explanation.definitionFit: He was a medieval philosopher and physician, a scholar from long ago.

clue.text: Clouds in otherwise blue area in northeast

indicators.note: in tells you the pieces sit inside the compass abbreviation
otherwise means in a different way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Clouds appear in an otherwise clear blue sky over the northeast.
explanation.definitionFit: Nebulae are vast interstellar clouds of gas and dust.

clue.text: Current publication with extremely egregious pictures

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A current magazine features shockingly bad pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Images are pictures or visual representations.

clue.text: Whip snake's first firm egg

indicators.note: the first letter of the word

parts.note: to egg on is to urge

explanation.surface: A whip, a snake and an egg make an odd still life.
explanation.walkthrough: Egg is the verb, as in egg on.
explanation.definitionFit: A scourge is a lash used for flogging.

clue.text: Lacking focus regularly leads to failing grade

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter is taken

parts.note: F is the fail grade in exams

explanation.surface: Lack of concentration often results in a fail.
explanation.walkthrough: Leads joins the pieces, while to is used as written.
explanation.definitionFit: Out of means having none left, as in out of milk, so lacking.

clue.text: Animals run out over grass at back of pasture

parts.note: RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out

indicators.note: in a down clue over means turned upward, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass

indicators.note: the back of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Livestock bolt across the grass at the far end of a field.
explanation.walkthrough: Run out is a way of being dismissed in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Roe deer are a small species of deer, so they are animals.

clue.text: King in Bilbao oddly beginning to head in the direction of Mecca

indicators.note: take the odd-numbered letters, first, third and so on
the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Spanish king starts to set off towards Mecca.
explanation.walkthrough: The kiblah (qibla) is the direction Muslims face when praying.
explanation.definitionFit: The qibla, also spelt kiblah, is the prayer orientation towards the Kaaba.

clue.text: Ten hours travelling well away from the North Pole

definitions.text: well away from the North Pole

indicators.note: letters on the move end up in a new order

explanation.surface: A ten-hour journey takes you far from the Arctic.
explanation.definitionFit: Southern means located in the south, the side of the globe far from the Arctic.

clue.text: Gold plating ultimately added onto an instrument

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter

explanation.surface: Gold plating has been added to an instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: An organ is a keyboard instrument with pipes.

clue.text: Big city accommodating strange bird

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so the city holds the other piece

parts.note: NY, New York, the Big Apple

explanation.surface: A metropolis plays host to an unusual bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The noddy is a tropical tern.

clue.text: Audible drop in level

indicators.note: audible means heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a tear is a drop from the eye

explanation.surface: A noticeable fall in standard.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is a row or layer, one of several levels.

clue.text: Godlike angels lie around

indicators.note: around means scattered about, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Angels lounge about in a divine setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Omniscience, seeing everything, is an attribute of a deity.

clue.text: Fellow lied about location of information in database

indicators.note: about signals that the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A man lied about where the data is kept.
explanation.definitionFit: A field is the slot in a database record that holds one item of data.

clue.text: Went back in ocean

indicators.note: back means the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: went, as a euphemism, means urinated, which is peed

explanation.surface: Someone returned into the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: Went looks like simple movement but is the coy sense of going to the loo.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep is a poetic name for the sea.

clue.text: New equipment cases for band

indicators.note: cases means encloses, so the equipment goes round the letter

parts.note: a rig is a set of equipment

explanation.surface: Fresh gear-cases for a group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: Band suggests a musical group but means a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring is a circular band, such as one worn on a finger.

clue.text: Flying predator overlooking very large victim

indicators.note: overlooking means ignoring, so a piece is left out

parts.note: the fish-eating raptor, a hawk that hunts over water
OS is outsize, the clothing size

explanation.surface: A hawk looms over a very large target.
explanation.walkthrough: Overlooking pictures the bird looking down, but it means leaving out.
explanation.definitionFit: Prey is a creature hunted by a predator, its victim.
